adaptation_verdict.rule: adapted minus student paired margin difference > width of the student's 95% F1 CI on the same files, in >= 2 of 3 domains

student.rule: per language: argmax over tau of median per-file (F1_observed - mean_F1_H0), calibration files only, k=0; ties -> smaller tau

teacher.rule: per language: argmax over tau of median per-file (F1_observed - mean_F1_H0), calibration files only, k=0; ties -> smaller tau
